title: Fix a concurrent job queue
prompt:
You are working in a Go repository in the current directory. Read README.md: it states the contract this package must satisfy. The visible tests cover only part of that contract.

Fix queue.go and worker.go so all four numbered rules hold.

Constraints: do not edit any _test.go file; standard library only; keep the exported API unchanged.

Run `go test ./...` and `go test -race ./...`. When both pass, stop. Do not add files, do not run external linters, do not refactor beyond the fix.
contract: Every job added before Close is processed exactly once.
Add, Len, Drain and Close are safe to call concurrently.
Start(ctx, n) must not process anything when ctx is already cancelled, and must leave no goroutine running after Wait.
Processed() returns the number of jobs handled and is race-free.
